resources.string: Send new failure reports to your configured LogDate server. Off by default.
Automatic reporting is unavailable for this account or server. Local export remains available.

Send only new diagnostic events to %1$s. Reports include phase and result codes, retry counts, timings, byte counts, and random operation/request references. They exclude journal content, titles, transcripts, media, filenames, paths, private hostnames, credentials, and keys. Historical local events are not uploaded. Reports expire from online server storage after 7 days. Infrastructure backup retention is separate.
Turning this off stops optional client reports and removes unsent reports. The server still records the operational information needed to process requests.
Remove your diagnostic reports from online storage at %1$s. This does not delete journal content or copies you shared. Infrastructure backup retention is separate.
